title: News Releases
slide_intent: Show how a press officer can identify the issuing office while giving journalists familiar places to find the contact, release date and story.
strategic_value: NASA can make a center release and a headquarters release recognizable as one family of communications.
demonstration: Two filled-in releases use the NASA News masthead, a ruled division and typewritten copy. The issuer and news items change between them.
practical_value: Lay out a new press release by holding the masthead and typing conventions steady while substituting the office, contact, release information and story.

content_islands.name: Guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title at left with the note that both versions follow the letterhead typing standard.

content_islands.name: Release pair
content_islands.spec: Align equal-size headquarters and center samples side by side. Keep the masthead, address, rule, release information, headline and paragraphs together in each example.
